say:2:1541118001:1.text: I didn't expect word of Morgan's corpse studies to reach Halia. Maybe you shouldn't have built your work place so close to the city, Morgan.
say:2:1541118001:1.source_cn: 我没料到研究逝者之事会传入呼临，也许安息间应当设置得再远些。

say:3:1541118002:1.text: People see it and the first thing they feel is fear.
say:3:1541118002:1.source_cn: 离城邦太近，的确容易引起恐慌和抵触。

say:4:1541118003:1.text: Close? Come on, Merlin, my place is already well away from Halia.
say:4:1541118003:1.source_cn: 近？梅林，安息间已经离呼临很远了。

say:5:1541118004:1.text: With the famine going on, only the ones with food to spare have time to go fussing over stuff like that. The hungry don't have the strength.
say:5:1541118004:1.source_cn: 饥荒当前，只有家有余粮的人才会去那里找麻烦，饥民可没有...

say:6:1541118005:1.text: No point worrying about what they think. Ordinary folks were never going to understand what we're doing anyway.
say:6:1541118005:1.source_cn: 何必在意他们的想法。凡人不能理解我们的事业，这是常事。
